serialKiller.relaisDebut: Answer the whole series, then pass the phone.
serialKiller.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
serialKiller.jaugesTitre: What stands out in your answers
serialKiller.modesDesc: The fifteen situations are the same. Solo, you find out which killer you're most like. As a couple, each of you answers separately and you compare your two portraits.
serialKiller.modeDuoDesc: Taking turns on the same phone, or each on your own with remote mode.
serialKiller.setupTitreSolo: Which serial killer are you compatible with?
serialKiller.setupDescSolo: Fifteen situations from a Halloween night: the party, the cemetery at midnight, the true crime documentary, the detective knocking at the door. Answer honestly: the portrait you get is the one that looks most like you, blown way out of proportion.
serialKiller.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first player answers the fifteen situations, passes the phone, and the second answers in turn. Both portraits show up at the end, side by side.
serialKiller.avertissement: A Halloween quiz, just for fun: it only talks about character traits, exaggerated to the point of caricature.
serialKiller.memePortrait: The same killer for both of you: run away together, or stay together, your call.
serialKiller.portraitsDifferents: Two different killers: at least you won't be competing.
serialKiller.noteFin: This quiz is a Halloween game. The people named here had real victims; this only talks about character traits, exaggerated to the point of caricature.
serialKiller.p_bundy_d: The easy smile, the line that puts everyone at ease, the perfect-son-in-law look. Like him, you know people trust you within two minutes, and you use it. People follow you without quite knowing why, and they realise it afterwards.
serialKiller.p_bundy_a: On Halloween night, you're the one who opens the door to the kids: the costume changes nothing, they'll hand you their candy.
serialKiller.p_dahmer_d: You struggle to let people go, you keep everything, you prefer your apartment to the rest of the world. When you like someone, you'd want them to never leave again. In your case, that means hugs that last too long and a lot of “stay a little longer”.
serialKiller.p_dahmer_a: For Halloween, invite people over, but leave the door open. And sort through your collections, it'll reassure the guests.
serialKiller.p_ripper_d: Nobody really knows who you are, and you like it that way. You walk at night, you say little, you remember everything, and your childhood friends couldn't tell you what you do with your weekends. A hundred and thirty years later, they're still looking for him.
serialKiller.p_ripper_a: The ideal Halloween costume: top hat, long coat, and you tell no one where you're going after the party.
serialKiller.p_zodiac_d: You love being hunted. Codes, riddles, letters with double meanings, clues left on purpose: you can't help toying with the people trying to understand you. And you'd hate to be forgotten.
serialKiller.p_zodiac_a: At Halloween, you're the one organising the treasure hunt. But promise to give the solution before midnight, this time.
serialKiller.p_manson_d: You do nothing yourself: you talk, you convince, and the others end up thinking like you without noticing. In a group, you're the one who decides, even when everyone believes they chose.
serialKiller.p_manson_a: For Halloween, you're the person who picks the movie, the costume and the time. At least let the others pick the candy.
serialKiller.p_btk_d: Family, job, neighbours who wave at you: your life looks so normal that nobody would think of looking behind it. You're patient, methodical, and you keep your secrets in neatly organised binders. Thirty years without anyone suspecting a thing.
serialKiller.p_btk_a: Your house will be the best decorated on the street for Halloween, perfectly symmetrical. Nobody will ask questions, as usual.
serialKiller.p_wuornos_d: You have the survival instinct of people who've taken too many hits. You get angry fast, you love hard, you slam the door on your way out and you come back. With you, nothing is calculated: everything is reaction.
serialKiller.p_wuornos_a: On Halloween night, avoid haunted houses where people jump out at you: the first one who scares you will regret it.
serialKiller.p_holmes_d: You build, you plan, you make money out of everything, and your house always has one more room than planned. An elegant swindler, a friendly pillar of the community, and a plan behind every smile.
serialKiller.p_holmes_a: For Halloween, don't offer to show people around your house. Especially not the basement.
serialKiller.q1: Halloween night, you push open the door to the party. Your entrance:
serialKiller.q1a: A smile for everyone, three first names memorised in two minutes, and the host is already introducing me to their parents
serialKiller.q1b: Through the back door, long coat, collar up: nobody saw me come in
serialKiller.q1c: With the four friends who've followed me everywhere since summer; we settle in a corner and they wait for me to speak
serialKiller.q1d: I don't come. I stay home, it's better at home
serialKiller.q2a: Top hat, cape, a lantern in hand, and fog if the weather plays along
serialKiller.q2b: A costume with a coded message on it: only one person will understand it, and they won't sleep again
serialKiller.q2c: The perfect neighbour: ironed shirt, bowl of sweets, a smile for every kid
serialKiller.q2d: Mad architect, rolls of blueprints under my arm, a secret room drawn on every one
serialKiller.q3: A true crime documentary starts. You:
serialKiller.q3a: I hit pause every two minutes to solve the riddles before the police do
serialKiller.q3b: I note what got him caught: thirty quiet years, then a floppy disk, what a shame
serialKiller.q3c: I only watch the part about his followers: how do you get people to follow you like that?
serialKiller.q3d: I watch it alone, lights off, and I don't tell anyone about it
serialKiller.q4: In the funfair haunted house, an actor jumps out at you in the dark.
serialKiller.q4a: He gets my elbow in the ribs before I've realised he's an actor
serialKiller.q4b: I smile at him, we chat, and on the way out the whole crew lets me go round again for free
serialKiller.q4c: I didn't see anything: I was looking at where the fake walls and hidden doors were
serialKiller.q4d: I vanish into the fog room; it takes the group ten minutes to find me
serialKiller.q5: A noise in the street, in the middle of the night. You pull back the curtain:
serialKiller.q5a: I note the time, the car's plate and a description of the guy, in the notebook I keep for that
serialKiller.q5b: I go out to look, in my pyjamas, kitchen knife in hand, and too bad for whoever's out there
serialKiller.q5c: I close the curtain: the street is other people's world
serialKiller.q5d: I wake the whole house and the six of us go out to look; I walk in front
serialKiller.q6: Inside an old book from the flea market, a letter covered in symbols.
serialKiller.q6a: I spend the whole night decoding it, and in the morning I write back something even more complicated
serialKiller.q6b: I first check whether it's a building plan: an extra room is always interesting
serialKiller.q6c: I read it out loud to the group, like a prophecy, and two people already believe it
serialKiller.q6d: I file it under 'letters', between 'bills' and 'garden'
serialKiller.q7: Someone humiliated you in front of everyone. Your revenge:
serialKiller.q7a: A smile, and I make them lose their friends one by one, without them ever working out where it's coming from
serialKiller.q7b: My friends take care of it, without my asking. Or almost
serialKiller.q7c: Right away, very loudly, in front of the same people
serialKiller.q7d: A letter it'll take them months to understand
serialKiller.q8a: Tidied to the millimetre, every box labelled, the light comes on by itself
serialKiller.q8b: There's a room the plans don't mention, and I'm not saying where
serialKiller.q8c: My collections, my keepsakes, the things I can't bring myself to throw away; people don't go down there
serialKiller.q8d: A party basement, well lit, with photos of me arm in arm with everyone
serialKiller.q9: A detective knocks on your door and asks questions about the neighbourhood.
serialKiller.q9a: I offer him a coffee, we talk for an hour, he leaves charmed and with nothing
serialKiller.q9b: I answer point by point, with dates: the ideal witness, it's reassuring
serialKiller.q9c: I slam the door, then open it again to tell him what I think of the police
serialKiller.q9d: I wasn't there, nobody saw me, and he doesn't insist
serialKiller.q10: The cemetery, at midnight, on a dare.
serialKiller.q10a: I walk alone between the graves, at ease; it's the others who are scared
serialKiller.q10b: I read every epitaph and stay long after everyone else has left
serialKiller.q10c: I sit everyone in a circle and talk; after an hour, nobody wants to leave
serialKiller.q10d: I'm the one who made the dare, and I'll be the last to go home, to prove something
serialKiller.q11b: Being forgotten, nobody talking about me anymore
serialKiller.q11c: Someone finding out what's behind the facade
serialKiller.q11d: Nothing anymore, I've had my share
serialKiller.q12: Your horror film for the night:
serialKiller.q12a: An investigation with coded letters sent to the newspapers
serialKiller.q12b: A cult deep in a forest, with a very calm leader
serialKiller.q12c: London in the fog, gas lamps and footsteps in the alley
serialKiller.q12d: A hotel with corridors that lead nowhere
serialKiller.q13: The town council asks you to run the village haunted house. You:
serialKiller.q13a: I accept, and I charge three times the planned price thanks to a 'secret room'
serialKiller.q13b: I accept for the neighbourhood kids: flawless set, schedule to the minute
serialKiller.q13c: I talk ten volunteers into doing it for me; they'll thank me
serialKiller.q13d: I give the tour in person: everyone follows me into the dark without asking questions
serialKiller.q14: A stranger stares at you and asks: 'Haven't we met somewhere before?'
serialKiller.q14a: I deny it with a big smile, then invite them for a drink
serialKiller.q14b: I disappear into the crowd without answering
serialKiller.q14d: I sell them something before they have time to realise
serialKiller.q15: Your nickname in the newspaper, if you had to have one:
